subject: what pro actually unlocks
preheader: free screens the purchase. pro adds repeatable decision workflows.
headline: Free screens a rental. Pro solves and stress-tests the decision.
body: Free covers a first-pass screen: cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, NOI, cash flow, a secondary Screening Index, and selected-rule fit. It also saves up to 5 deals. The Screening Index is for triage—not evidence readiness, an appraisal, lender approval, or investment advice. No card is required for the free analyzer.

Pro adds editing and unlimited saves, a target-dependent Offer Ceiling, sensitivity, BRRRR and fix-and-flip models, 10-year projections, Illustrative Tax Impact, modeled exits, comparison, mortgage scenarios, detailed rehab inputs, Buy Box screening, and PDF decision reports. The Offer Ceiling is not a recommended offer. See the pricing page for the current price and complete feature list.

Pro is designed for repeat analysis and deeper scenarios. Whether it is worth upgrading depends on your workflow and how often you need those features; no software can guarantee that it will catch every issue or improve an investment outcome.
Eligible first-time subscribers can review the current trial and billing terms on the pricing page. Returning subscribers start paid access immediately.
